name: fold-opted-in-pre-edit-of-another-case-is-refused-where-the-disk-folds-case
description: Session A takes EXCLUSIVE on data/x.txt; session B then pre-edits DATA/X.TXT with if_unheld: true. On a case-insensitive disk (caseless) B is refused other_holder naming A, as for data/x.txt; where the disk keeps case apart (nfd, none) DATA/X.TXT is another file and B is admitted: no refusal. Both spellings are listed in tracked.yaml, so DATA/X.TXT is tracked on every disk by its own literal pattern; this row cannot tell that admission from an untracked one, which answers the same {ok: true}. Fold 06 is the row that shows the second spelling is its own tracked record there. B presents its principal on Python, where an opted-in request needs one; the claim is scoped to Python and the header is omitted on Node. Both backends.
